主要内容: On February 16, 2016, the Compensation Committee of SanDisk Corporation (SANDISK) approved bonuses for fiscal year 2015, base salaries, and target bonus percentages for fiscal year 2016 for its named executive officers. The approved 2015 bonuses for the Named Executive Officers were: Sanjay Mehrotra (President and Chief Executive Officer) $472,500, Judy Bruner (Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Financial Officer) $195,300, Sumit Sadana (Executive Vice President, Chief Strategy Officer and General Manager, Enterprise Solutions) $146,560, Mark Brazeal (Chief Legal Officer and Senior Vice President, IP Licensing) $84,000, and Shuki Nir (Senior Vice President, Corporate Marketing, and General Manager, Retail) $81,900. Effective February 22, 2016, the base salaries for these officers were set at: Sanjay Mehrotra $1,050,000, Judy Bruner $670,530, Sumit Sadana $558,260, Mark Brazeal $412,000, and Shuki Nir $432,600. The target bonus percentages for fiscal year 2016 remained the same as for fiscal year 2015, as a percentage of base salary.
